text:
Maya L.: morning async — quick updates from me. finished the UX pass on the rollout banner and pushed the spec updates to https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/412. no blockers, but want feedback on the language for migration notes.

Devin K.: saw the PR, leaving comments now. main question: do we need a migration job or can we handle with a soft flag? :thinking_face:

Maya L.: prefer soft flag for first cut, plan a migration job in next sprint if rollout shows errors. added a small checklist in the PR description.

Ashley R.: blocked on model catalog mapping — I need the final field names from the runtime team to wire the UI. pinging @Samir P. for the schema change.

Samir P.: sorry, was deep in an infra deploy. schema change is merged: keys are `model_variant`, `quantized`, `latency_profile`. putting a sample payload here:
```json
{
  "model_variant": "redwood-v2-8b-q4",
  "quantized": true,
  "latency_profile": "p95-60ms"
}
```
should unblock Ashley.

Ashley R.: thanks — will update UI bindings and push a small fix. ETA end of day.

Oliver W.: FYI — I bumped the priority on the canary for Dedicated customers; ops wants the early rollback hook enabled. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deployments/pull/879

Maya L.: adding that to the launch checklist. who can review the canary runbook? @Devin K. and @Oliver W.?

Devin K.: I can review runbook tonight. main ask: add a quick checklist for SLO smoke tests (qps, p50/p95, error-rate).

CI Bot: build #4823 failed on `integration/canary-smoke` — flaky test `routes_timeout_spec` (timeout at 120s). <ci.redwood/c/4823> :warning:

Samir P.: noted. I’ll re-run and investigate the timeout — likely due to KV cache warmup on staging.

Maya L.: for prioritization: we still have two backlog items to decide — (1) auto-rollout on success vs manual toggle, (2) embed cache eviction policy. propose we defer (2) to next sprint and ship (1) with manual toggle first. thoughts? :thumbsup:

Oliver W.: +1 to manual toggle first. we should instrument telemetry so we can flip later without code changes.

Ashley R.: agree. deferring eviction policy makes sense — it needs ML input.

Devin K.: approving manual-first approach. I'll schedule a quick 20-min sync after lunch to lock wording in the spec.

Maya L.: perfect. last: PR reviewer pings — please check these if you can:
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/412 (spec wording) — assigned to Devin, Oliver
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/deployments/pull/879 (canary hook) — assigned to Oliver, Samir
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/222 (model catalog bindings) — assigned to Ashley

Samir P.: re-running CI now. will post results.

CI Bot: build #4823 re-run passed. :white_check_mark:

Maya L.: thanks everyone — if no further blockers I’ll mark the launch checklist item as ready and move the ticket to REVIEW. ping here if anything pops up. :rocket:
